description: O’Keeffe standing in the landscape in partial shadow at sunrise or sunset while looking down and holding a partial animal skull with an upper jaw of teeth in one hand.   She is dressed in a dark short sleeved shirt and matching skirt, wearing navy Keds PF flyer sneakers.  Her hair is pulled back, and she wears a white jacket tied around her waist.
title: Untitled, Georgia O'Keeffe
